fields.value: Stress, Strain, and Temperature measurement data for AISI 301 and AISI 316 stainless steels from tension tests with a sudden increase of strain rate

dsDescriptionValue.value: This publication comprise data obtained during a tension test where the strain rate was suddenly changed from 10-4 s-1 to 1.3x103 s-1. The sudden increase in strain rate was carried out at different amounts of plastic strain. The tests were carried out with a modified tension Split-Hopkinson Pressure bar device. The force was measured from the stress bars using strain gages, whereas the strain was measured using high speed photography and digital image correlation. The temperature was measured using high speed infrared imaging. The data is part of the original publication in Journal of Dynamic Behavior of Materials. The original manuscript is available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40870-022-00333-y

publicationCitation.value: Strain Hardening and Adiabatic Heating of Stainless Steels After a Sudden Increase of Strain Rate
